answer_text: KB does not specify a numeric limit on how many BGP routes a Socket can accept from a neighbor before the session is affected. Two recommended methods to reduce the number of advertised routes to Cato are: 1) Advertise Aggregated (Summarized) Routes by summarizing internal prefixes; 2) Apply Route Filtering to exclude infrastructure, transit, or non-WAN-relevant prefixes.
